correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md §§1–4. Expand the factorization using 24y²−8y−1=0. The bounds 5/12<y<4/9 give b>s>0, b+s>1 (equivalently 4s²>y), and c²<b²<1/2. Thus the witness has exactly the claimed contacts on [c,1]. Rotate the complement of a gap into a centered closed interval and integrate the witness against the arbitrary positive measure: any longer gap retains only the positive contact, contradicting the first moment. At equality the first cosine moment fixes positive fiber totals and the witness fixes the fourth cosine moment. The two sine ratios U₃(c)>0>U₃(b) force equal splits. The reflected pairs are not generally antipodal; this wording slip does not affect the stated angles or proof. Independent 60-digit evaluation of 2π−2 arccos(c) gives 2.569356100631680534…, consistent with the display. The symbolic companion checks algebraic identities, not the universal positivity-measure inference; its recorded run was not treated as a fresh verification.
